cached_comparison: Native128px cell, existing288 caches; no new inference.
cohort_rule: Same18 pairs, all16 cells each, including all zeros. No replacements or label-selected ROIs.
engineering_followup_rule: Proceed to a separate mixed-quality cache extension only if free-coarse+cell restores positive overlap in both reference-positive events, improves pooled overlap with no pooled reference-precision drop vs cached native128, exceeds blank+cell covered reference pixels overall, and adds reference coverage beyond corresponding free-coarse-only ROI in both events. Report every condition regardless of rule outcome; no statistical or novelty claim.
evaluation: All18 scene mosaics, all3 events and pooled severe-reference coverage/precision/false pixels, plus paired gains/losses. Report null recall for zero-reference events; no label fitting.
input_boundary: Coarse-context transform accepts only two64px coarse images and the selected pair of128px patches, not a512px high-resolution scene. Model output and boolean for each paid observation may depend on those only.
native_only_scope: This diagnostic covers native observations only. Mixed native/blur budget8 search cannot be scored until an equally frozen blurred-cache extension exists.

new_conditions.input: Purchased native128x128 RGB cell only, upsample512x512 BILINEAR for each date.
new_conditions.name: patch128_to512
new_conditions.output: Predict512 binary severe mask using fixed decoder, reduce to128 with NEAREST; recompute >=4px declaration from canonical128 mask.

new_conditions.input: 512x512 RGB canvas filled with (124,116,104), then paste purchased128px native cell at its original grid position for each date.
new_conditions.name: blank512_plus_native_cell
new_conditions.output: Keep only exact128px ROI prediction; ignore every output pixel outside purchased cell.

new_conditions.input: Free64x64 BOX coarse RGB per date, upsample512 BILINEAR, then paste purchased128px native cell at its original position.
new_conditions.name: free_coarse512_plus_native_cell
new_conditions.output: Keep only exact128px ROI prediction; ignore every output pixel outside purchased cell.

new_conditions.input: Same free64px BOX RGB upsampled512 BILINEAR; no native-cell paste.
new_conditions.name: free_coarse512_only
new_conditions.output: Whole-scene coarse-only diagnostic, and fixed per-cell ROIs for marginal-information comparison. Do not pretend coarse-only pixels require paid observations.

positive_controls: Replay same2 locked positive control crops; any unequal pixel stops before new18-scene conditions.
precision: Same fixed model, tensor normalization, eval mode, seed and CPU/MPS settings as stage1.
question: Can a large-input interface recover reference overlap using only free coarse RGB and one purchased128px cell?
required_preflight: Synthetic geometry, resize inversion, identical coarse context outside ROI across cell modes, no unseen-native access, and boolean threshold tests. Lock implementation hashes before model calls.
